동네.x: There are lots of parks in my neighborhood.
동네.e: 동 (village) + native 네. City neighborhoods are named 'X동' in addresses.

컵.x: Please pour water into the cup.
컵.e: From English 'cup' — also used for glasses: 물 한 컵 = a glass of water.

등산하다.m: to hike, to go hiking, to climb a mountain
등산하다.x: When the weather is nice, I go hiking with friends on weekends.
등산하다.t: Hiking is hugely popular in Korea; you'll see colorful 등산복 (hiking outfits) on every weekend trail.

붙다.m: to stick, to be attached; to pass (an exam)
붙다.x: This time I really want to pass the exam.
붙다.e: Basic meaning is 'to stick'; passing means your name sticks on the list.
붙다.t: Pronounced [붇따]; 붙다 is the casual way to say 합격하다.

충전기.x: I didn't bring my charger, so I borrowed one from a friend.

경험.x: Have you ever had experience working abroad?
경험.e: Literally 'going through a test' — what you learn by living it.
경험.t: Say -(으)ㄴ 경험이 있다 for 'have experienced': 가 본 경험이 있어요 = I've been there.

장점.ex: 이 휴대폰의 장점은 가볍고 싸다는 거예요.
장점.x: The good thing about this phone is that it's light and cheap.
장점.e: Literally 'long point', where you measure up well.
장점.t: Pronounced [장쩜]; it pairs naturally with its opposite 단점.

쿵.x: The child fell off the bed with a thud.
쿵.e: 의성어 (sound word) for a dull, heavy thud. Its bright-vowel partner 콩 is a small, light bump.
쿵.t: Verb: 쿵쿵거리다 'to thump around', a common complaint about noisy upstairs neighbors. 가슴이 쿵 내려앉다 = 'my heart sank'.

협회.x: My father is a member of the Korean Chefs' Association.
협회.e: Literally 'cooperative gathering' — members joined for a shared goal.

증가율.x: This year the population growth rate hit 0% for the first time.

맑음.ex: 일기 예보를 보니까 내일은 하루 종일 맑음이에요.
맑음.x: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be clear all day.
맑음.e: Noun form of 맑다 'to be clear' plus -음, used as a forecast label.
맑음.t: Pronounced [말금] — in ㄺ, the ㄱ moves over to the next syllable.

증언.ex: 목격자의 증언 덕분에 범인을 잡을 수 있었어요.
증언.x: Thanks to the eyewitness's testimony, they were able to catch the criminal.

뚜렷이.ex: 어릴 때 살던 집이 아직도 뚜렷이 기억나요.
뚜렷이.x: I still clearly remember the house I lived in as a child.
뚜렷이.t: Spelled 뚜렷이, not 뚜렷히; stems ending in ㅅ take -이.

여유롭다.x: On weekends I spend relaxing time at a cafe.
여유롭다.e: From 여유 'surplus room' + -롭다 'having' — having time or space to spare.

자가격리.ex: 확진자랑 밥을 먹어서 일주일 동안 자가격리를 했어요.
자가격리.x: I ate with a confirmed case, so I self-quarantined for a week.
자가격리.e: 自家 'one's own home' + 隔離 'separation, isolation' — isolation at home.
자가격리.t: Pronounced [자가경니]. Also spelled 자가 격리; used with 하다 or 들어가다 (자가격리에 들어가다).

보편성.ex: 이 이야기는 시대를 넘는 보편성을 가지고 있어요.
보편성.x: This story has a universality that transcends its era.

상술하다.m: to explain in detail, to elaborate
상술하다.x: I will explain the details in the next chapter.
상술하다.t: Don't confuse it with the noun 상술 'sales tactics,' as in 상술에 넘어가다.

창호지.m: traditional paper for doors and windows
창호지.x: Grandpa pasted new paper on the door.
창호지.t: Usually made of 한지; it lets in soft light and air, and was traditionally re-pasted in autumn before winter.

규모의 경제.forms: 규모의 경제를 누리다 · 규모의 경제 효과
규모의 경제.ex: 대기업은 규모의 경제 덕분에 생산 비용이 낮습니다.
규모의 경제.x: Large companies have lower production costs thanks to economies of scale.
규모의 경제.e: A direct translation: 규모 'scale' + 의 'of' + 경제 'economy.'
규모의 경제.t: The particle 의 here is usually pronounced [에]: [규모에 경제].

국빈.ex: 대통령은 공항에서 외국 국빈을 직접 맞이했습니다.
국빈.x: The president personally welcomed the foreign state guest at the airport.

경도되다.m: to be drawn toward, to lean heavily toward (an idea); to be captivated
경도되다.ex: 그는 젊은 시절 급진적인 사상에 경도되었습니다.
경도되다.x: In his youth, he was drawn heavily toward radical ideas.
경도되다.e: Literally 'lean and topple': being so attracted to an idea you tilt toward it.
경도되다.t: Usually A에 경도되다, often with a critical tone about ideologies or trends.

약진하다.m: to make great strides, to advance rapidly
약진하다.ex: 그 기업은 해외 시장에서 크게 약진했습니다.
약진하다.x: The company made great strides in overseas markets.

착취하다.m: to exploit, to squeeze (labor or resources)
착취하다.ex: 그 공장은 어린 노동자들을 착취해 비판을 받았습니다.
착취하다.x: That factory was criticized for exploiting young workers.
착취하다.e: Literally 'squeeze and take' — wringing value out of people.
rel: to use, to take advantage of

축출하다.m: to expel, to oust, to drive out
축출하다.x: The party expelled the corrupt lawmaker.
축출하다.e: Literally 'chase out' — forcing someone from a group or position.

청구권.x: The victim has the right to claim damages.
청구권.t: Pronounced [청구꿘]; often preceded by the thing claimed, e.g. 손해배상 청구권.
